by M1 in the title block. The first 
revision date 
 13 May 2002

items: Wear safety helmet, safety boots.
Safety helmet, safety boots,

Check for correct Location of fire extinguishers, check
 condition of extinguishers (fully charged and in good working condition,
 validity of expiry date)

Check for availability of first aid kit, check
 content and replace as necessary.

Test all emergency generators if on site, fuel tank
 should be at least 3/4 full.

Check
 all normal lighting fixtures, replace burnt out light bulbs or fluorescent
 tubes,

Test
 all emergency DC light fixtures, replace any burnt out light bulbs

Dust
 off control and relay panels

Check
 device indicating light, replace as required

Check
 relay targets, report any relay flags to Protection Engineer

Check
 for portable earthling equipment- must be in good repair and properly stored.

Check
 insulated switch sticks - be properly stored and in good condition, note
 date of last inspection.

Inspect
 station ladders-must be in good repair and properly stored.

Check
 safety barrier rope-there must be sufficient quantities and it must be
 properly stored

Check that all floors are properly cleaned and free
 of tripping hazards

Check that all
 washrooms are clean and in good working order.

Check that
 compressor room floor is clean and free of oil spills.

Check that all
 windows are clean and in good working order

Check
 that all equipment is labeled probably 
 (names are written) according to the single line diagram

Check
 for unusual noise and smells, exhaust and ventilation systems must be in
 good working order

Check
 that all safety barriers are in place, all switching cell doors must be
 locked, all warning signs in place, 
 all spare breakers and mobile service equipment (oil filtration unit, SF6
 gas cart) must be properly stored

Check
 control panels painting are in a good condition and cleaned.

Check
 that property fence is in good repair, check that all earth connections to
 fence and gates are secure and tight.

Check
 all earth connections to all steel structures & equipment, tighten
 connections to station earth grid or earthing rods.

Inspect
 gravel layer in yard, there must be no weeds, ensure there is no debris
 (plastic bags) present.

Check
 that all warning signs in place to keep the public out

Check
 that switched lighting is in working order, replace burnt out lights.

Inspect
 condition of all porcelain bushings, report any contamination,

Check 
 for birds nest.

Check
 for correct oil level in all oil filled bushings.

Check
 disconnect and earthing switches, inspect for correct position of linkage in
 open or closed position.

Check
 for condition of cable trenches, all covers must be in place.

Check
 for condition of cable trenches, all covers must be in place.

Inspect
 oil containment pits, must be clean and dry

Check
 all equipment reinforced concrete foundations to see they are in good
 condition and there are no cracks.

Check
 all the main transformer wheel brakes to ensure they are in the correct
 position.

Check
 the condition of outside painting and ensure they are in a good condition
 and there is no rust.
